Hi Sean —

We ran a quick smoke of the evening concurrency sweep you provisioned and hit a higher-than-expected token burn once the simulated agents kicked in. The current trial allowance will cover baseline tests but we need an interim top-up to validate 95th percentile tail latency across 10k concurrent sessions for a 3-hour soak.

Can you — or someone on your side — temporarily bump our sandbox allowance by ~250k tokens (ephemeral quota only for the test window) and add a short note on retention so our security team is comfortable? We want to run the soak on Thursday evening (May 20) PDT between 10pm–1am.

Thanks,

Quick proposal: Redwood provides a one-time 250k token ephemeral uplift scoped to the test window. Tokens will be consumed from a temporary sandbox allocation and removed after 48h. We'll require an acknowledgement on expected date/time and a short timeframe for log retention (we keep inference logs for 30 days by default for POCs unless otherwise requested).

Monica/Marissa — can you confirm if we can authorize 250k tokens for EDGE-8241 for the 3-hour window on May 20? If Finance needs anything, Aditya (cc'd) can confirm the cost write-off/credit accounting.
